gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-docs-skill-te.description: <What it does and when to use it, in one or two sentences. This is what an agent matches on. At most 1,024 characters.>

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-shared-ad-ang.description: Research supported advertising promises from a specific buyer's context, current product facts, customer language and observed ads. Turn them into static, video or copy ideas; match video ideas to actual recipes and save a product-scoped angle bank for write-video-ad-script. Product-led discovery can use verified facts without reviews. Reference persistence and reach are observations, not proof of performance.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-shared-ad-cam.description: Analyze ad campaign performance data (Google, Meta, LinkedIn) to identify what's working, what's wasting budget, and specific cut/scale/test recommendations. Runs statistical analysis, funnel diagnostics, and multi-channel budget reallocation with specific dollar-amount shift recommendations and scenario modeling.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-shared-ad-lea.description: For paid lead-gen and participant-recruitment ads, replaces vanity CPA with true CAC per qualified lead by joining ad-platform data with downstream funnel events, surfaces tracking gaps, and classifies every creative into Scale / Keep / Investigate / Cut.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-shared-ad-man.description: The intake stage of a Meta ad harness. Researches the brand first, states what it assumes, and asks only what it cannot infer and what would change money, claims or legal exposure if guessed wrong — at most four questions a turn, in plain business language. Writes the brand's stable facts (ads/brand.md), the campaign brief, and a log of what was asked vs assumed. Use it when someone wants to run Meta ads and the brand's ad facts are not yet recorded.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-marketing-ad-.description: Checks paid ads against the ad platform's rules (Meta, TikTok, Google, LinkedIn and others) and the brand's category rules: the copy, on-image or on-screen text, pictures and people. Rewrites what can be fixed honestly, adds the disclosures that are needed, and flags anything that needs a human or legal review, with one pass, fixed or flag line per ad and platform. Use alone when you already have the ad text or images and know where they will run; otherwise run the playbook for the job (e.g. make-static-ads, make-content, email-lifecycle).

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-shared-ads-no.description: Turn a brand's facts, a campaign brief and the product into a one-minute Meta ad strategy with its reasoning — goal, audience, objective and placements, budget split, how many ads and how different they must be (generate 3x so the user can choose), the test frame, the success metric, and safety rules for the user to accept. Decides what launch-meta-ad-campaign then executes, and re-reads the strategy after a deep check to show which assumption changed. Use it after intake and before any creative is generated or any campaign is built.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-marketing-ana.description: Weekly performance read across every channel we run: what worked, why, and what to make next, judged on the business's real number (store revenue, qualified pipeline, retained users), not platform claims. Use when: write my Monday report; how are my ads doing — which ad won?; are my ads actually making money (Meta says 4x ROAS but revenue is flat); why did sales drop this week; did the test win; is my tracking working; monthly numbers for the replan; anything on fire today. Not for acting on the recommendations (pausing, scaling, launching) — use run-paid-campaigns; not for replanning the…

Step of the analyze-performance playbook: calls ended tests, scores last week's calls, writes this week's kill/scale/hold calls and drafts learnings for the brand brain. Run analyze-performance instead; not for direct use.

Step of the analyze-performance playbook: flags tracking breaks with fixes and explains each big metric move with evidence, confidence and ruled-out causes. Run analyze-performance instead; not for direct use.

Step of the analyze-performance playbook: gathers the week's numbers from tools, exports and pastes, cleans them, and writes the coverage line or switches to claims-only mode. Run analyze-performance instead; not for direct use.

Step of the analyze-performance playbook: ranks creative by angle, hook and format with spend gates, writes short per-channel reads and drafts what to make next. Run analyze-performance instead; not for direct use.

Step of the analyze-performance playbook: joins cleaned store or CRM numbers with ad spend to build the business-truth table, MER, new-customer cost and the overclaim ratio. Run analyze-performance instead; not for direct use.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-video-animate.description: Animate an existing product image or static ad into a short branded video using the GooseWorks Animate Images workflow, with source-image continuity and optional end-frame control.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-shared-answer.description: Answer questions about a brand's Meta ads (spend, results, which ad is winning, is it paused, why did Goose do that) only from reads made in the same turn, with the data window and sync time on every number and a plain caveat when the connection is stale or partial. Use it whenever a user asks how their ads are doing or why an ad action was taken.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-shared-brand-.description: Research a company or brand from its website and produce a reusable Brand Core covering products, audience, competitors, positioning, offers, messaging evidence, voice, and visual identity. Use before growth, ad, content, creator, or product work when reliable brand context is missing.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-video-caption.description: Burned-in captions for a finished vertical video, three kinds. transcribe.py gets word timings from the video's own audio through the GooseWorks proxy (fal Whisper, charged to your GooseWorks credits, cents); captions.py burns one to three words at a time with Pillow + ffmpeg (no libass needed), either pinned to a split-screen seam (plate 25% above / 75% below) or at a fixed height, in a plate, outline or one-word serif style, with an optional red hook card; plates.py burns per-beat caption blocks (black, one union silhouette, placed in the emptiest band) for formats with no voice. The last…

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-marketing-cla.description: Checks every claim in a piece of copy (ads, emails, posts, pages, scripts, briefs) against the claims the brand has approved. Keeps, rewrites or cuts each line, and lists the proof that would bring a cut line back. When a line the copy needs has no approval, it asks for a short sign-off on the 3 or 4 lines that matter and records the answer. Use alone when you already have the copy and a brand set up; otherwise run the playbook for the job (e.g. make-static-ads, make-content, write-outreach).

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-shared-commen.description: Mine comments and replies on social posts, videos, and ads for recurring customer language, questions, objections, desired outcomes, complaints, product requests, purchase signals, and creative opportunities. Use for voice-of-customer research grounded in linked source evidence.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-shared-compan.description: Find decision-makers at a specific company using Fiber, Crustdata and PDL people search inside the GooseWorks coworker. Given a company name and target titles, returns a list of contacts with name, title, LinkedIn URL, and location.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-shared-compet.description: Scrape competitor ads from Meta, TikTok, Google, and LinkedIn ad libraries, analyze creative patterns (hooks, formats, CTAs), reverse-engineer landing page funnels, and produce a strategic teardown with vulnerability analysis and counter-play recommendations. Use when you need to understand the competitive ad landscape, find new creative directions, or identify weaknesses in a competitor's paid strategy.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-video-compose.description: Composite a generated creator track into a product layer, per beat — in the creator's zone on split beats (either side of a seam), full frame on creator beats, hidden on product beats — with the creator's voice as the audio (loudness -14 LUFS) and an optional ducked music bed, or a music-only or silent master for voiceless formats. Free, local ffmpeg. Pairs with footage-cutlist (the layer) and create-creator-takes-h3 (the creator). Use for split-screen (with an optional zoom and brand-colour seam bar), screen-insert and any creator-over-product format.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-video-create-.description: Render pixel-accurate Apple Notes (iPhone, light mode) screenshot mockups from a JSON note spec. Outputs HTML + PNG at the iPhone 16/15 Pro native 1180×2556. Supports paragraphs, images, checklists, dividers, autocorrect underline, smart quotes, and an optional iOS keyboard chrome overlay used by the parent video-ad molecule.

Render pixel-accurate ChatGPT mobile (iOS) screen mockups in light mode from a thread JSON. Supports user text bubbles, user image attachments, assistant markdown prose, citation chips, the OpenAI spiral logo, the Apps-SDK GPT chip in the composer, and three header styles (model-tag, plain title, "Get Plus"). Fixed 9:16 viewport. Outputs HTML + PNG.

Generate an AI creator talking to camera, saying an approved script, as one continuous track — H3 Max reference-to-video through the GooseWorks fal-proxy (charged to your GooseWorks credits). Plans takes on line boundaries under H3's 15s cap, dry-runs a cost estimate, generates the first take alone so its voice can be locked and passed to every later take, joins takes with measured 0.10s dissolves, and moves each line's timing onto the words actually spoken. Use for any format with a generated creator speaking a script (split-screen, screen inserts, talking-head ads).

Generate or edit an image via any FAL image model (nano-banana edit, gpt-image, flux, ...), routed through the GooseWorks proxy, so the call is charged to your GooseWorks credits. image_urls must be public URLs; --image puts a local file on the fal CDN first. The recipe names the model + prompt. Use for keyframes, flat-cover transforms, product hero edits. (For the OpenAI gpt-image family specifically, create-image-gpt-image-fal also exists.)

Generate a single photoreal or designed image with OpenAI gpt-image via fal.ai. Supports gpt-image-1 (default, fixed sizes — the FAL fallback for Higgsfield's `gpt_image_2`) and gpt-image-2 (`openai/gpt-image-2`, custom output sizes up to 3840px). Routes to text-to-image or the edit variant depending on whether a reference image is provided. Use for photoreal character anchors, scene keyframes, and designed sheets (e.g. storyboards) where precise layout and legible text matter.
Render pixel-accurate iMessage screenshot mockups (DM or group) from a thread JSON. Supports minimal, with-keyboard, and full iPhone 15 Pro frame variants. Outputs HTML + PNG.
Render a deterministic text-only video ad from approved copy, font, colors, timing and CTA. Use when a brand needs an animated message without product photography or a creator.

Generate an instrumental music bed via ElevenLabs Music, routed through the GooseWorks proxy, so the call is charged to your GooseWorks credits. Trims any sparse intro, loudnorm, fades the tail. Prompt + length from the template recipe. Use for the music layer of any video-ad format.

Image-to-video (or text-to-video) via any FAL video model (Kling, Seedance, Veo), routed through the GooseWorks proxy, so the call is charged to your GooseWorks credits. The template recipe names the model + params; image_url inputs must be public URLs (the orchestrator hosts local frames with the MCP media_upload). Returns the result video URL and downloads it. Use for the generative base clip of any video-ad format.

Generate a single 4-15s vertical video clip with ByteDance Seedance 2.0 reference-to-video via fal.ai, for shots with no realistic face (a product hero, a product in motion, an empty set). Multi-image reference (product + setting), ambient audio, internal multi-cut handling within one render, 720p by default. Routes through the GooseWorks FAL proxy (charged to your GooseWorks credits). Seedance refuses photoreal faces, so talking heads and creators go to creator-h3 / video-h3max.

Generate a voiceover (VO) clip via ElevenLabs text-to-speech, routed through the GooseWorks proxy, so the call is charged to your GooseWorks credits. Voice id + script text come from the template recipe. Use for the spoken narration of VO-driven video-ad formats (cgi-app-sizzle, flat-vector-explainer, hypermotion). Never call ElevenLabs directly — the proxy attribution is required.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-marketing-ema.description: Lifecycle email, SMS and push: audits the list and deliverability, then writes the flows this kind of business needs first, loadable as-is in your own tool, plus segments, cadence and this week's broadcasts. Never sends anything. Use when: set up my welcome and abandoned-cart emails; trial onboarding or waitlist launch emails; win back lapsed customers; plan this week's emails and texts; push notifications for my app; why are my emails going to spam; plan our Black Friday email and SMS sends; a send went wrong. Not for cold outreach to prospects — use write-outreach; not the editorial…

Step of the email-lifecycle playbook: builds the month's send calendar and writes this week's email and SMS broadcasts against the approved cadence and segments. Run email-lifecycle instead; not for direct use.

Step of the email-lifecycle playbook: writes one lifecycle flow as a build sheet for the brand's email tool, every message finished in the brand voice. Run email-lifecycle instead; not for direct use.

Step of the email-lifecycle playbook: audits list, consent, live flows, recent sends and sending setup, marking every item verified, from-you or unknown. Run email-lifecycle instead; not for direct use.

Prices one discount, free-shipping threshold or referral reward against contribution margin: cost per order, share of margin used, break-even lift, code leakage risks, and one recommended offer in two plain sentences. Use alone when you already have the offer, average order value and margin per product; otherwise run email-lifecycle.

Checks a drafted email flow or broadcast before it is loaded: flow logic and exits, overlaps, offer depth and codes, stock, claims, consent and legal footer, SMS rules, rendering, voice and AI-copy tells, and the goal metric. Returns a pass / fixed / open-question table. Use alone when you already have the finished draft and the brand's product and policy facts; otherwise run email-lifecycle.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-video-footage.description: Watch a brand's own product footage (screen recording, product film), pick the moment that proves each line with the user, and render those picks as a product layer — free, local. survey.py turns footage into timestamped contact sheets + scene cuts + motion so the agent can actually look at it; the agent writes a cut list (beat → source window + framing); preview.py draws it as a review sheet the user corrects round by round; cut.py renders the approved list into a silent 1080x1920 layer with the creator's area left as a plate. Also frames footage as a filmed screen (keystone, bezel, handheld…

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-shared-get-br.description: Get company logos, brand colors, fonts, and style guides

Use when the existing community formats (carousel, story, infographic, slides, poster, chart, tweet, plus community additions) don't fit the user's canvas — e.g., LinkedIn banner 1584×396, story cover 1080×1920, event flyer 8.5×11in. Mirrors goose-graphics-create-style but for formats.

End-to-end skill that turns a single reference image into a published Gooseworks style — analyzes the image, drafts the slim style spec, renders a hero example plus 2-3 additional formats via Playwright, writes the `gooseworks-style.json` manifest, and publishes via `npx gooseworks styles publish` so other agents can discover it. Mirrors goose-graphics-create-format but for styles.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-entry-goose-p.description: Make product photos (studio, lifestyle or on a model) of a brand's real products with GooseWorks in this chat. Start brand work with brand_knowledge_browse and follow the next_step in every answer.
gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-entry-goose-p.author: GooseWorks

Make an approved GooseWorks video when an answer's next_step gives its command.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-entry-goosewo.description: GooseWorks growth coworker and router for markets, competitors, audiences, creators, campaigns, ads, photos, graphics, video, content, email, SEO, social, leads and contacts. Use for brand facts or copy too, so offers, prices, rules, audience and bestsellers reach the brand's Marketing Brain.
gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-entry-goosewo.author: GooseWorks

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-shared-hacker.description: Search Hacker News stories and comments using the free Algolia API. No Apify token needed. Use when you need to find HN discussions, track mentions, discover Show HN launches, or monitor tech community sentiment.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-marketing-hon.description: Shared step of the marketing playbooks (make-static-ads, run-organic-social): how to review generated images and video honestly. Covers what was seen by eye versus read automatically, findings framed as things for the human to confirm, remakes only after a yes to the price, and at most two tries per item. Loaded by those playbooks; not for direct use.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-marketing-imp.description: SEO and AI-answer visibility. Use for a site SEO or technical audit with ranked fixes, competitor keyword and topic gaps, a topic cluster, SEO metrics for domains, a programmatic SEO page-set plan, or checking where ChatGPT and Google name the brand. Delivers the requested audit, comparison, map or blueprint with dated evidence and clear data limits. Also covers app store listings and local search. Drafts changes; never edits live. Full pages go to make-content; paid search goes to run-paid-campaigns.

Step of the improve-search-visibility playbook: runs the agreed buyer questions on AI and Google surfaces, records every run and scores how often the brand is named. Run improve-search-visibility instead; not for direct use.

Step of the improve-search-visibility playbook: checks the profiles answer engines read, plus local listings and reviews, against the brand's facts and writes corrections. Run improve-search-visibility instead; not for direct use.

Step of the improve-search-visibility playbook: turns one ranked fix into paste-ready site copy or code with owner, risk and undo, and writes page briefs. Run improve-search-visibility instead; not for direct use.

Step of the improve-search-visibility playbook: audits site indexing, crawling, technical and page issues at the requested scope, or checks pages behind lost visibility questions. Run improve-search-visibility instead; not for direct use.

Step of the improve-search-visibility playbook: drafts and scores the buyer-question set in AI and Google forms and groups it into page clusters. Run improve-search-visibility instead; not for direct use.

Audits an app's App Store and Google Play listing against three competitors (title, subtitle, description opening, first screenshots and captions, rating, review themes) and writes a field-by-field rewrite with character counts, or a launch-day listing before release. Use alone when you already have the app's store links and signed-off product facts; otherwise run improve-search-visibility.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-shared-job-po.description: Detect buying intent from job postings. When a company posts a job in your problem area, they've allocated budget and are actively thinking about the problem. This skill finds those companies, qualifies them, extracts personalization context, and outputs everything to a Google Sheet. Does NOT do outreach — just delivers qualified leads with reasoning.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-shared-launch.description: Take someone from a business goal to a verified, paused-then-live Meta/Facebook/Instagram campaign without making them learn Meta's hierarchy. Use automatically for requests to launch, run, create, publish, set up, or plan Meta ads; use reporting skills for analysis-only requests.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-shared-lead-q.description: Lead qualification engine with conversational intake. Asks structured questions to understand your qualification criteria, generates a reusable qualification prompt, then batch-enriches leads via Apify LinkedIn scraping and scores them with parallel processing. Outputs qualified/disqualified verdicts with confidence scores and reasoning to CSV or whatever output format the user prefers. Supports calibration mode for prompt refinement.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-drafts-market.description: Learn my brand once and stop asking me every time. Use when someone says learn my brand, set up my brand, here's our brand book, remember how we talk, what can we claim, can we say this, approve our claims, sign off our voice, our price or product changed, the client approved the claims, pick up where we left off, or check our claims are still current. Reads what GooseWorks already found about the brand, asks only the gaps as drafts to confirm, audits every claim (including ones research marked approved) and gets the ones that matter signed off with proof, scope and review date, turns the…

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-shared-linked.description: Scrape recent posts from LinkedIn profiles using Apify. Use when you need to monitor what specific people are posting on LinkedIn, track founder/exec activity, or gather LinkedIn content for competitive intelligence.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-marketing-mak.description: Writes marketing content: articles, single posts, newsletters, scripts and repurposed cuts, each with an edit note and a claims check. Use when a marketer says "write a blog post / case study", "write a LinkedIn or X post / thread / X article", "carousel copy", "draft this week's newsletter", "turn this webinar into posts" or "repurpose this", "write a TikTok or YouTube script", "refresh this old post", or "write the page from this SEO brief". Words only; nothing is invented or published. Not for a dated posting calendar — use run-organic-social; not ad copy (make-static-ads) or promo emails…

Writes a one-page content brief before any draft: audience, intent, the one arguable point, what top results already say and what this piece adds, an outline, a proof inventory with gaps marked, voice, CTA and banned words, checked against six gates. Use alone when you already have the topic, format, audience and destination and want only the brief; otherwise run make-content.
Step of the make-content playbook: mines one finished asset into scored quotable units and maps a different lead unit to each platform. Run make-content instead; not for direct use.

Edits an existing draft in order: a substance pass (arguable thesis, swap test, fakes removed, CTA fit), a claims and fact check that cuts or softens unproven lines, a readability and voice-match pass, then an AI-tell sweep, with an edit note listing open gaps. Use alone when you already have a finished draft and the brand's voice samples and approved claims; otherwise run make-content.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-entry-make-cu.description: Create a custom video with sourced product accuracy, explicit sound routing and exact-final audiovisual review.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-drafts-market.description: Use when the marketer says: studio photos of my product without a shoot, product photos for my store page, packshots on white, lifestyle or on-model shots, photos for the new colourway, fresh product imagery for ads, photos for our launch page, our packaging changed — redo the photos, I have no photographer. Delivers store-ready product photos generated from the brand's real product photos: a shot list built from the page slots (hero, alt angle, scale, detail, in use, lifestyle, on-model), only real photos of this product as references, matched to the brand's photography, every shot checked…

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-marketing-mak.description: Make new static image ads, a fresh batch, more ads, a winner's variations, copy variants or a rejected ad fix. Reads the brand, its customers and the ads it already runs, turns real product facts and customer situations into distinct visual ideas, shows a concept board, writes each render prompt, quotes, renders and reviews through GooseWorks. Also handles requested branded header/social graphics. Use for static ad creation rather than goose-ads. Not for video, product photos or launching campaigns.

Step of make-static-ads: writes the text for each slot the ad's template sets, then the primary texts, headline, description and CTA around the image, from usable facts and customer words. Run make-static-ads instead; not for direct use.

Step of the make-static-ads playbook: pulls every claim-bearing span out of an ad — the copy around the image, the on-image words in the prompt, badges, and what the picture implies — and keeps or cuts each by the brand-brain rule. Runs before spend on the finished prompt (Pass A) and on every render (Pass B). Run make-static-ads instead; not for direct use.

Step of make-static-ads: writes each ad's render prompt and ordered image list from its concept-board row, one per ad and ratio, ready for a quoted render. Run make-static-ads instead; not for direct use.

Step of make-static-ads: turns the chosen angles into messages, visual ideas and a template per ad, checks each against the brand profile and recent ads, writes the concept board and has a fresh critic attack it before any copy, prompt or spend. Run make-static-ads instead; not for direct use.

Step of the make-static-ads playbook: after an image is approved, makes more versions of the same picture with different hooks, headlines or fonts by a quoted re-render with the approved render attached as the brand's own image, so copy can be tested without new visuals. Offered, never default. Run make-static-ads instead; not for direct use.

Step of make-static-ads: picks a template for every ad in its chosen style, after its visual idea and style are set, from the brand's own ads, the GooseWorks library or category leaders, and records what the chosen creativity level keeps from it. Run make-static-ads instead; not for direct use.

Step of the make-static-ads playbook: fixes a static image ad the platform rejected — finds the ad, maps the platform's reason to the line or element at fault, fixes copy for free or re-composes the image text on a quote, re-runs the claims and policy checks, and answers the request. A rejected video is the video playbook's job. Run make-static-ads instead; not for direct use.

Makes one simple non-ad brand graphic, such as an email header, social feed or story image, or a blog or link-preview image, in the brand's style with at most a short line of text, after claim and rights checks and a yes to the quote; returns the link and alt text. Not for carousels, decks or print. Use alone when you already have the purpose, placement and exact wording; otherwise run make-static-ads.

Step of make-static-ads: a fresh judge checks every render against its concept-board row and the official product photos, one retry inside the marketer's approval, then the claims and set checks; records each verdict in tags and the batch file. Run make-static-ads instead; not for direct use.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-drafts-market.description: Use when the marketer says: make me a video ad, a 30-second ad for paid social, a Reel / TikTok / Shorts ad, a UGC-style video made with AI (no real creator), a product demo video, remake this ad I like for my brand, cut our best organic video into an ad, more like my winning video with new hooks, my video ad got rejected — fix it. Delivers a produced, ready-to-post video ad grounded in a researched angle: one message, a hook for the first two seconds, every claim traced to the brand's signed-off claims, no generated person posing as a customer, the exact words and the price approved before…

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-marketing-mar.description: How to get live public data (ads libraries, social posts and comments, search results, creator profiles), business identity/work-contact reads, domain SEO metrics and paid media generation through GooseWorks, with no vendor key. Load before any playbook step that reads public data or calls an outside model: which proxy call fits the job, what it costs, how to get the human's yes, and what to do when the data is not reachable. Not for brand facts (read the brand brain) or the customer's own ad accounts (the GooseWorks ads tools, or an ads connector they have).

How every GooseWorks marketing playbook runs: connecting, picking the brand, where files go, the shared claims, money, research and schedule rules, and the index of what each playbook saves and who reads it. Load at the start of any playbook run. Not a marketer ask: for "what should I do first?" use where-to-start.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-video-media-p.description: Shared helper that routes ALL paid media generation (FAL image/video, ElevenLabs music) through the GooseWorks proxies so every call is charged to your GooseWorks credits — never a provider SDK's default host. Host-swaps the FAL queue URLs, loads the agent token from the sandbox env (GW_MEDIA_PROXY_TOKEN) or ~/.gooseworks/credentials.json, and returns the result CDN URL. Every video-ad media capability imports this; templates never call a provider directly.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-shared-meta-a.description: Front door and loop owner of a Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad harness. Reads the brand's ads/ docs, works out which campaign the user means and which stage it is at, hands off to the stage skill that runs it (intake, strategy, creative, launch, checks, fixes, answers), and writes every stage change back to the docs. Use it when someone wants to run ads on Meta, comes back to ads they started earlier, a stage skill hands back, or a scheduled check fires.

Pre-flight policy check for Meta ads. Takes ad copy plus advertiser context, resolves and fetches the relevant Meta transparency-center policy pages at runtime, and returns a Pass / Fix Required / Block verdict with cited findings and rewrites.

Diagnose Meta Ads campaign performance and account gaps using Meta's actual system mechanics — including customer-journey coverage, Breakdown Effect, Learning Phase, Auction Overlap, Pacing, and Creative Fatigue. Use for performance diagnosis, account audits, full-funnel or TOF/MOF/BOF gap analysis, deciding what to test or create next, and producing novice-friendly recommendations without forcing every campaign or ad into a funnel stage.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-video-mix-mas.description: Canonical short-form-ad audio mix in one FFmpeg pass. VO loudnorm + 3.0× per-clip + 2.0× mix, music 0.13 base + apad+afade, sidechain compress 20:1 @ 0.01, climax line +20%, optional video-to-music duration sync. Replaces the reactive multi-round tuning that cost v03 6+ passes.

Correct speech written differently ("5mg" said "five milligrams", "30%" said "thirty percent", a spoken URL, "don't" said "do not",…

Loaded by those playbooks; not for direct use.

Use alone when you already have the draft, the brand's voice and approved claims; otherwise run run-organic-social.

Runs the paid leg of an approved plan: checks tracking, pages and stock before money moves, then stages one weekly proposal of kills, scales, pauses, swaps and launches, each with its reason and a check date. Nothing changes without your yes. Use when: launch these ads; it's Monday — kill, scale or pause?; swap this fatiguing ad; we sold out or the sale ended — pause the ads now; an ad got rejected or the account got restricted; we're in a brand crisis — hold the ads; give me the Google, TikTok or LinkedIn changes to make. Not for how the ads did or which ad won — use analyze-performance; not…
Step of the run-paid-campaigns playbook: stages the week's approval items, applies only what the marketer approves and keeps the change log. Run run-paid-campaigns instead; not for direct use.
Step of the run-paid-campaigns playbook: turns the weekly read into scale, pause, hold, rotate and fix recommendations within the spend ceiling. Run run-paid-campaigns instead; not for direct use.

Checks that ads are safe to spend on: conversion tracking recording, landing pages loading on mobile with the right product, price and offer, enough stock behind promoted products, no disapproved ads, and no account or payment stop. Marks each pass, fail or unknown and turns fails into fixes. Use alone when you already have the live or planned ads and their landing pages; otherwise run run-paid-campaigns.

Step of the run-paid-campaigns playbook: reads each platform's last mature results window against the allowable cost, as evidence for the week's moves. Run run-paid-campaigns instead; not for direct use.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-marketing-sav.description: Shared step of the marketing playbooks (make-static-ads, analyze-performance, email-lifecycle, write-outreach): saves a short brand rule or finding in the human's own words, one idea per rule, retires the playbook's own older rules it replaces, and reads the result back to confirm. Loaded by those playbooks; not for direct use.

Shared step of the marketing playbooks (research-market, plan-campaign, make-content, analyze-performance): saves a finished file to the brand and makes it searchable. It either replaces older versions or keeps dated history, then checks that the file can be found. Loaded by those playbooks; not for direct use.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-shared-scrape.description: Provider reference for collecting public profiles, posts, comments, transcripts, trends, and ad-library data from major social platforms through ScrapeCreators. Use as a dependency of research workflows, not as the final user-facing deliverable.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-marketing-spe.description: Shared step of the marketing playbooks (make-static-ads, research-market, run-paid-campaigns, work-with-creators): gets the human's yes before any credits are spent. Shows the price exactly as quoted, or asks for one yes to a credit ceiling for paid data reads, stays under it and logs each charge. Also covers scheduled runs. Loaded by those playbooks; not for direct use.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-video-stitch-.description: Stitch video segments with ffmpeg concat, xfade, overlay, audio mux, and export settings, and trim a source into named clips at exact windows (trim_clips.py). Ships montage.py, a free montage assembler (python3 + ffmpeg, no keys). It takes a JSON EDL of clips and stills, normalizes them and hard-cuts them in order, burns captions from an SRT, a cue list or word timings, and lays a VO over a music bed that ducks under it, mastered to -14 LUFS.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-shared-transc.description: Turn TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Reddit, or Rumble transcripts into timestamped hooks, claims, objections, proof, calls to action, sponsorship signals, and reusable content atoms. Use directly for transcript analysis or as support for creator, competitor, trend, demand, and repurposing work.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-video-ugc-fix.description: the UGC fix-loop toolkit — surgically re-render a bad window/beat of a single-take UGC master (stitch_replacement.py, pure FFmpeg) and GPT cross-model review a Seedance prompt before render (vet_seedance_prompt.py, routed through the openai-proxy). Fetch it into a one-shot UGC recipe so both scripts resolve on any machine and the vet call charged to your GooseWorks credits.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-video-verify-.description: QC gate for a generated static ad image — verify the file opens, matches the requested dimensions, shows the correct product/subject (right shape, colour, label, logo), and has no garbled text or severe artifacts. Records pass/fail/needs-human in verification.md. Used as the final check in the static ad remix flow before shipping.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-video-video-p.description: Full video production sequence with script review, actual ingredient choices, controlled generation, editing, evidence-based quality review, polish, captions and delivery. A host binding supplies project storage, authentic approvals, provider access and billing.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-marketing-voi.description: Builds or updates a voice card from a company blog ("extract our blog voice") or how an account or person actually writes, measured from about 8 or more of their real posts (length, casing, emoji, openings, pet phrases, opinions with their source). When there are too few posts, it runs a short interview instead. It ends with a test that checks a draft against the card. The brand's rules always beat the card. Use alone when you already have the account's posts or the person on hand; otherwise run the playbook for the job (e.g. run-organic-social, write-outreach, email-lifecycle).

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-video-watch.description: Observe actual video and sound over the whole file or named ranges, with timestamped evidence and honest coverage. Use complementary playback, listening and targeted frames; return observations without edits or verdicts.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-marketing-whe.description: First-move advice for a broad growth or marketing ask with no job named: looks at what GooseWorks already knows and at the site, asks a few short questions in one message, names the one thing in the way, and sends the marketer to the right next job. Use when the marketer says "help me grow my brand", "I need to grow my business", "how do I get more customers / sales", "help me with marketing", "where do I start", "sales are flat", "what should I focus on this month", or "I'm back, what's next?". Recommends only; never runs the work. Not for a named job like "make me ads" or "grow my…

Step of the where-to-start playbook: saves the founder's answers and the agreed first move with the brand, so later visits and other playbooks don't ask again. Run where-to-start instead; not for direct use.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-marketing-wor.description: Real creators and influencers, researched, priced and briefed. Use when the marketer says "find influencers", "which creators are worth paying, at what price?", "find real UGC creators to film for our ads", "who should we seed product to", "is this creator's engagement real", "what should I pay this creator" or "write a creator brief". Free research first; one credit yes only to vet deeper. Drafts only: contacts nobody, agrees nothing, moves no money. Not for AI-made UGC-style video — use goose-video; if unsure, ask: a real person filming, or AI-made?

Writes a one-page brief for one creator you have already picked: hook ideas in their format, at most three approved must-say lines, never-says, the disclosure for their platform, deliverables, timeline, the usage-rights ask and two examples. Adds a short first-message draft (gift and paid versions) for you to send. Use alone when you already have the creator, their best fitting post and the goal; otherwise run work-with-creators.

Step of the work-with-creators playbook: builds and screens a long list of creators from fans, category creators and search, and ranks finalists to vet next. Run work-with-creators instead; not for direct use.

Vets creators you have already named from their public pages. Covers the median views of their last 12 to 20 posts (sponsored and organic apart), a read of their comments, how often they post, audience fit with how sure it is, about 12 months of brand-safety checks, rival partnerships and rules for regulated categories. Gives a verdict with dated numbers for each one. Use alone when you already have the creator handles and the brand's goal; otherwise run work-with-creators.

Prices a creator you have already vetted. Gives a low and a target fee from median views and the platform's typical cost per 1,000 views, a walk-away ceiling from your goal and margin, and usage rights priced on their own. Checks against real quoted rates and recommends gift, paid, affiliate or a mix, with one line showing the math. Use alone when you already have the creator's recent view numbers, your goal and your unit cost; otherwise run work-with-creators.

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-marketing-wri.description: Cold outreach a person sends to business buyers: email and LinkedIn sequences, a first line per prospect, reply and objection answers, and a read of replies. Use when the marketer says "write a cold email sequence", "what do I send to this list", "write LinkedIn messages for these leads", "how do I reply to this prospect" or "handle this objection", "reply to this demo request", "win back or reconnect with accounts that churned or went quiet", or "why is nobody replying to my outreach". Drafts only; the marketer sends from their own tool. Not for finding the people — use research-audience;…

Step of the write-outreach playbook: the brief a helper follows to write one segment's email and LinkedIn sequence, first lines and replies from rows and an angle prepared earlier. Run write-outreach instead; not for direct use.

Step of the write-outreach playbook: the checks a finished outreach pack and send file must pass before delivery, covering facts, proof, compliance, length, asks and tone. Run write-outreach instead; not for direct use.

Step of the write-outreach playbook: sorts outreach replies by type, matches each to its prospect row, sets that person's status and keeps useful exact words. Run write-outreach instead; not for direct use.

Turns findings you already have into a report a marketer can read in 30 seconds. It has a short summary with key findings and how sure each one is, the first move, decisions needed, at most six next moves, what was not checked, and dated sources. It checks length and wording before handing over, then saves the report to the brand. Use alone when you already have the findings and their sources; otherwise run the playbook for the job (e.g. research-market, research-competitors, plan-campaign).

gooseworks-ai-goose-skills-video-write-v.description: Write or revise a short-form ad from a sourced angle and reference. Plan connected words, product proof and sound; expose production gaps before script review.
